fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-12-05, a white motorcycle bearing registration number TN-33-XX-1090 belonging to the complainant was taken from Vetri Colony Industrial Area. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-04 at roughly 08:45. The complaint was lodged by Chithra Devi (9000000176). No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Ezhilan Palanisamy (9000000181) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, motorcycle, witness, morning, industrial area, photograph
